concepts.prompt: Create one landscape 16:9 visual concept art mockup for an illustrated Brazilian folklore psychological horror visual novel called Afogados em Terra Seca. This is an illustrator's exploratory UI art study, not production UI. Style: expressive black pen-and-ink outlines, dense hand stippling and crosshatching on warm pale aged paper, muted sepia and charcoal, faint moss/old-brass undertones, handmade illustrated storybook, restrained eerie atmosphere. NO photorealism, no 3D, no mobile game fantasy gold chrome, no glossy panels, no neon, no gore. Composition must clearly show readable choice labels over quiet untextured areas while leaving much of the background art visible. Crisp typography with readable Portuguese accents, literary serif but never illegible calligraphy. Only the specified short Portuguese text. A tiny footer reads "ESTUDO VISUAL". Draw a genuinely distinctive art-directed concept. CONCEPT: choices as torn fragments of the narrated story. Main scene: inviting yet uneasy fantasy riverside wooden tavern, tables, timber beams, shuttered windows, fireplace, no people needed. Lower right: three horizontally long, vertically stacked pale paper strips with subtle individually different torn contours; broad clear type areas, minimal border, delicate ink strokes extending from their edges. Choices exactly "Conversar", "Selecionar", "Voltar". Second strip has a dark plum-violet ink underline and an unmistakable small hand-drawn pointing arrow, demonstrating hover/focus; the text itself stays very dark and readable. Other strips are just pale paper, no outlined rectangular UI boxes. The paper should feel like an overlay from an illustrated narrator's manuscript, not floating ancient scroll cylinders. Negative space and excellent readable hierarchy. Make the choice cluster about half the image width and lower half height, plenty of room around words. The tavern occupies the rest.
